item.title: Beyond Meat CEO 'It's Just Not the Moment for Plant-Based Meat' After Rebrand
item.description:
📝 Beyond Meat CEO Ethan Brown has said, “It’s just not the moment for plant-based meat,” following the company’s recent rebrand. Beyond Meat rebranded as Beyond The Plant Protein Company last week, amid what Brown described as a “period of confusion” around plant-based proteins. Beyond Ground is nutrient-dense and made with just four ingredients.
